fullDescription: A premium, minimalist e-commerce design system tailored for luxury fashion rentals, high-end retail, or boutique lifestyle brands. The style features a sophisticated palette of zinc grays and rich amber accents, anchored by a high-contrast editorial layout. It utilizes a mix of bold display typography (Cabinet Grotesk) for impact and clean geometric sans-serif (Satoshi) for readability. Key features include a slide-out cart drawer, hover-triggered product actions, bento-style category grids, and 3:4 aspect ratio product photography. Suitable for high-ticket SaaS, designer marketplaces, and luxury service verticals.

structured.summary: A sophisticated luxury fashion rental marketplace style featuring an editorial typographic hierarchy, a monochromatic zinc-based color scheme with amber highlights, and smooth, drawer-based micro-interactions.

style.description: The style is 'Minimalist Luxury.' It uses Cabinet Grotesk for bold, tight-tracked headings and Satoshi for body content. The color palette is strictly #18181B (Zinc-900), #FFFFFF, and #F59E0B (Amber-500) for accents. Animations include cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) transitions for side drawers, 0.7s scale-up effects on imagery, and subtle slide-up toast notifications.
style.prompt: Apply a 'Modern Luxury' aesthetic. Typography: Headings in 'Cabinet Grotesk' (800 weight, -0.05em tracking), body in 'Satoshi' (medium weight). Palette: Primary #18181B (Zinc-900), Secondary #FFFFFF, Accent #F59E0B. Interactive elements: Buttons should have a letter-spacing of 0.1em and use uppercase text. Use 12px border-radius on cards and 9999px (pill) for filter tags. Shadows should be subtle (shadow-sm). For images, use a 3:4 portrait aspect ratio with a 0.7s ease-in-out scale-up (105%) on hover. Dividers should be 1px solid #F4F4F5 (Zinc-100). All transitions must use cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1).

layout_and_structure.description: The layout follows a high-density, vertical scroll structure with specific 'bento grid' sections for categories and a standard 4-column product grid.

prompts.prompt: Full-width bar at top, background #18181B, text #FFFFFF. Font: Satoshi, size 12px, 0.2em letter spacing, uppercase. Content should be centered with 10px vertical padding.

Height 80px, background #FFFFFF, border-bottom 1px solid #F4F4F5. Left: Logo (Cabinet Grotesk Extrabold, size 24px, tracking-tighter). Center: Navigation links (Satoshi, 14px, uppercase, bold). Right: Search bar (rounded-full, background #F9FAFB) and cart button (circular, #18181B, with Amber-500 badge).

Split layout. Left: Typography-heavy (Text: Cabinet Grotesk, 5xl-8xl, leading 0.9). Include a text-stroke element for specific words. Call to action: Solid primary button + underlined secondary link. Right: Full-bleed portrait image with a subtle left-to-right fade mask.

4-column grid on desktop, 2-column on mobile. Aspect ratio: 1:1 or 4:5. Cards feature full-bleed imagery with a bottom-heavy gradient overlay (black/60 to transparent) and white text in the bottom-left corner (24px Cabinet Grotesk bold).

4-column layout with 32px spacing. Product cards must have: 3:4 aspect ratio image, top-left brand badge (white backdrop-blur), top-right heart icon, and a slide-up 'Add to Bag' button revealed only on hover. Prices should be bold Cabinet Grotesk 18px.
Dark background (#18181B) with white/amber text. Left: Minimalist HTML table for sizing with 1px border-bottom on rows. Right: Vertical list of value props with 48x48px amber icons.

Slide-out component from right. Width: 448px. Backdrop: Black/50. Header: Border-bottom #F4F4F5. Content: List of items with price calculation and day-range quantity selector (+/- buttons). Footer: Total calculation and full-width checkout button.

special_ui_components.description: Small selection buttons found on product cards.
special_ui_components.prompt: Border 1px solid #D4D4D8, radius 4px, font-size 10px, bold. Hover/Selected state: Background #18181B, text #FFFFFF, border #18181B. Transition: 0.2s ease.
Fixed bottom-right position. Background #18181B, text #FFFFFF, radius 8px, padding 12px 24px. Animation: slide-up (0.4s) followed by a 2.2s delay and fade-out.
